text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I heard someone call for me...
Was it merely my imagination...?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............The Statue of the Three Goddesses,
huh.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—O Three Goddesses who watch over and guide
us.
Reverence to your exalted majesty.
Gratitude for your divine grace.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To repay your benevolence,
I shall devote myself to daily
improvement.
